meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: Claude 会把原始数据套用 Setup→Conflict→Resolution 框架和叙事弧，产出含图表、业务上下文、洞察与行动建议的汇报材料，方便讲给非技术受众。
howto.when: 向高管汇报、做季度业务回顾或投资者演示，或要把数据分析结论讲给非技术受众时使用。

say.text: 把这份流失数据讲成给高管看的 5 页故事，突出关键洞察和行动建议
say.note: 会按问题—解决框架组织，并给出可视化建议

say.text: 把 EMEA 和 APAC 的市场数据做成对比故事，最后给出推荐方案
say.note: 会输出加权评分对比与风险缓解要点

howto.what_en: Claude turns raw data into insight reports and decks for non-technical audiences, using a Setup-Conflict-Resolution narrative arc with visuals, business context and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Use it for executive briefings, quarterly business reviews, investor presentations, or when explaining data findings to a non-technical audience.

say_en.text: Turn this churn data into a 5-slide exec story with key insights and actions
say_en.note: Organizes around problem-solution with visualization tips

say_en.text: Rewrite this Q4 review with Setup-Conflict-Resolution, conclusion first
say_en.note: Reorders into hook, context, insight, action

say_en.text: Make an EMEA vs APAC market comparison story ending with a recommendation
say_en.note: Outputs weighted comparison and risk mitigation
